summary: Graph list responses have more pages exactly while paging.next is present (paging.cursors.after also rides on the last page of some edges), so --all follows paging.next reduced to its after= cursor, and a walk cut short by the page cap or a cursorless next link never reports complete.
reason: Meta's generated endpoint metadata omits pagination, so without the Graph fallback --all returns only the first 25 records; the earlier fallback followed paging.cursors.after alone, which asked for one page past the end and still reported complete after a truncation warning.
validated_outcome: Table-driven httptest test drives the ten real list and insights commands over a two-page Graph fixture whose last page keeps cursors but has no next, and fails on the old paging.cursors.after fallback and on a helper without the URL-to-cursor reduction; live read-only --all on a 4-campaign account makes 1 request where the previous build made 2, and on a 96-campaign list makes 4 requests where it made 5, with identical ids in the same order.

deferred_to_upstream.feature: Regenerate once the generator reads a URL-valued has_more_field (Graph paging.next) as a next link and its paged-read helper auto-detects the Graph envelope by paging.next presence (cli-printing-press#4836).
deferred_to_upstream.reason: The generator's next-link fallbacks skip Graph's nested paging.next and Meta's endpoint metadata omits pagination, so a regen would return only the first 25 records again.
